notes.title: Performance improvements, migration to URP, and other updates
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone! New patch![/h2]

[olist]
[*] I've rebuilt the entire game using URP. Performance has significantly improved, though graphics quality took a slight hit.
[*] The starting location has been redesigned. This is needed for future plans - I want to build a small town where players can buy property and set up either a farm or pharmaceutical production in the basement.
[*] The interface has been redesigned.
[*] Pause and settings menus have been redesigned.
[*] Character controller has been replaced with a more realistic one.
[*] Experience system and character levels have been implemented (needs testing, please report any issues via DM).
[*] Two new visitor templates have been added.
[/olist]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
[b]Top priority:[/b] complete the plant growing system and the creation of tinctures, pills, and ointments from dried medicinal plants. I also plan to add customization options for naming your own medicinal products (and packaging customization).

[b]Production process:[/b]
[list]
[*] Laboratory with various equipment (distillation unit, pill press, dryer)
[*] Recipes can be discovered through experimentation or found in-game
[*] Quality depends on herb freshness and process accuracy
[/list]

[b]Gameplay mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[*] Different herbs provide different effects
[*] Combining herbs can enhance effects or create new properties
[*] Preparation time affects effectiveness
[*] Incorrect preparation may result in side effects
[/list]
[b]Second priority:[/b]
[olist]
[*]"Town" location where players can buy their own house with a yard and garden
[*]Continued development of story mode
[/olist]

notes.title: Switch to Unity URP and fixing perfomance issues
notes.notes: Good day, friends! I've been working on optimizing the build for two days now and decided to switch to Unity URP. This will reduce the quality of the lighting (there's nothing that can be done about it, URP's default lighting is weaker), but it should significantly improve performance. The process is not complicated, but it's long and tedious — as of now, there's no fully functional method to automatically (or even semi-automatically) switch from HDRP to URP. I'll try to complete the transition as quickly as possible (I even took some time off work to do this).

notes.title: FPS drop problem
notes.notes: Hi everyone! It seems I made a mistake in the current build, which caused a drop in FPS. I’m aware of the issue and am working to figure out exactly what went wrong. I expect to fix it within a few days, and if necessary, I’ll switch to another Rendering Pipeline.

notes.title: Not very good news...
notes.notes: Hi guys! I've already submitted the build for Steam team review and suddenly discovered a critical bug - I'm stuck fixing the medicine control system and rewriting it from scratch because right now the entire game logic is falling apart. I don't even know how long it will take, since I've already spent four nights trying to fix the scripts. We'll have to wait another week, sorry guys.

notes.title: Development News #2
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone! The short week turned out to be really short, but I managed to make a couple of cool things and record some videos for you.[/b]

[previewyoutube=bAed9LL8LqQ;lefthumb][/previewyoutube]  The window washing system has been redesigned. The old method of "smearing" the cleaner on the glass really annoyed me, and I finally found a way to make surface cleaning more or less realistic. Still not perfect, so version 3 might be coming soon :>






[previewyoutube=1FfWOiFPhWg;lefthumb][/previewyoutube]Implemented water collection into a bottle. You turn on the water, take the bottle in your hands, fill it up, and then go water the plants. Otherwise, these plants just sit without water and don't grow. Don't forget to turn off the water, or the local utilities will hit you with a big bill for overuse.





[previewyoutube=p9M7XnHOhe4;lefthumb][/previewyoutube]Finished the first quest. Meet Dariga—the niece of Dr. Erlan (that's the guy who is treating your sister, a really cool dude). Dariga is a young activist from the "Shadows of the Mountains," offering assistance to the Player. She's a smart, cautious, and dedicated 25-year-old woman. An idealist with a practical approach. Her speech is always well-thought-out; she knows how to persuade without revealing too much. Dariga believes in the noble goals of her organization but also understands the risks and the necessity of secrecy.

notes.title: Good news, everyone!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone! [/b]

As the year comes to an end, I finally have some time to post something here. I'll try to do this more often, but right now, even setting aside time for development is a bit challenging. Game development is tough, it’s a long process... and it comes with uncertain prospects, which makes it mentally demanding too. Sorry, I didn’t come here to complain—I came to share something new!

In the utility room between the store floor and the storage area, I’ve put up a board that will periodically display hints for players. I hope this addition will be helpful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235622/cfbc6c94c4d0e410906c38700747e5eaaebf59c4.png[/img]

I’ve started developing a plant-growing system for future processing into natural (though not entirely legal) medicines. Huge thanks to Matthew Ware for the awesome asset (although it did put me over budget by two bottles of cola and a cheeseburger)! The plants will go through several growth phases. Their growth rate will depend on the current level of lighting and soil moisture—plants won’t grow in a dark, dry place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235622/2dd52aee45e02ef1dab6f11af159e2a91305f5c1.png[/img]

I’ve built a power system—refrigerators, lighting, and electronic devices will be connected to the grid, and in the event of a power outage, everything will shut down. Some medicines will start to spoil, plants will stop growing, and so on. Oh, and I made refrigerators!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235622/56bde2ff0d1e3e676a0c4f35184f40a66e5ffb14.png[/img]

I’ve also started working on the storyline. It seems the game might launch in early access with a plot. But that's not certain yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235622/71cd52ee0181b879e801f7f82d729f5561f970e7.png[/img]

That’s it for now—see you next week (or sooner)!
